scalar_convergence.rule: CONVERGENCE_TREND requires a common signed approach direction and strictly decreasing adjacent absolute changes; otherwise NOT_DEMONSTRATED

reason_for_amendment: The v4 extended run exposed that backend status=completed can accompany early termination at the declared pre-contact model-domain boundary.
Configured duration, actual end time, and termination reason must be distinct archived quantities; ordinary completed-status acceptance requires the configured duration to be reached.
The former hf_default_48x72_long10s case is transparently renamed as a time-to-domain-limit/performance-until-domain-limit case and cannot be cited as a complete 10 s stability or performance run.
A decreasing profile norm cannot hide a non-monotone decision-facing funnel-depth sequence.
